usage: article-publication-v2.py [-h] [--plan PLAN] [--registry REGISTRY]
                                 [--registry-sha256 REGISTRY_SHA256]
                                 [--output OUTPUT] [--runtime RUNTIME]
                                 [--build-output BUILD_OUTPUT]
                                 [--build-receipt BUILD_RECEIPT]
                                 [--approval APPROVAL]
                                 [--runtime-sha256 RUNTIME_SHA256]
                                 [--build-sha256 BUILD_SHA256]
                                 [--approval-sha256 APPROVAL_SHA256]
                                 {schema,prepare,verify,build,ready}

Explicit local version-2 article preparation; no publication or merge
authority.

positional arguments:
  {schema,prepare,verify,build,ready}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN
  --registry REGISTRY   Owner-reviewed control policy, never article-selected
                        metadata
  --registry-sha256 REGISTRY_SHA256
                        Expected digest supplied by the reviewed caller
  --output OUTPUT
  --runtime RUNTIME
  --build-output BUILD_OUTPUT
  --build-receipt BUILD_RECEIPT
  --approval APPROVAL
  --runtime-sha256 RUNTIME_SHA256
  --build-sha256 BUILD_SHA256
  --approval-sha256 APPROVAL_SHA256
